<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem claims manual letter creation/editing per claim status lacks automation. I checked the five most similar items: Organization settings (4138, unstarted), Claim information display (4135, in progress), Claims timeline roadmap page, Workspace administration (4131, completed), and Claim search refinements (4128, completed). None of the completed stories or roadmap items address letter generation or automation for claim statuses; all similarity scores are very low (0.05–0.07) and the content concerns settings, display, timeline, administration, and claim filtering instead.", "verdict": "pass"}
